{{recipe}}

'''Sponge cake''' is the most commonly recognised variety of baked confectionery in Britain. It has a sweet taste, often flavoured with vanilla, chocolate or other additions, and can be cut and displayed in a number of different ways.

An [[Cookbook:Sponge Cake|easier version of this recipe]] is available that does not require a kitchen scale.

==Ingredients==

=== Cake ===
* 200 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Caster sugar|caster sugar]]
* 200 g [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 200 g (4 whole) [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* 1–2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:vanilla|vanilla extract]]

* 200 g [[Cookbook:Self-rising Flour|self-raising flour]]
* 2 tsp [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]

=== Filling ===
* 2–4 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Jam|jam]], stirred
* [[Cookbook:Buttercream|Buttercream]] [[Cookbook:Frosting|frosting]]

=== Topping (pick one) ===
* 75 g [[Cookbook:Powdered Sugar|icing sugar]]
* 70 g [[Cookbook:Superfine Sugar|superfine sugar]]
* 65 g [[Cookbook:Granulated Sugar|granulated sugar]]
* 55 g [[Cookbook:Demerara Sugar|demerara sugar]]

==Equipment==
* 1 large [[Cookbook:Mixing Bowl|mixing bowl]]
* 1 set of [[Cookbook:Scale|scales]]
* 1 wooden spoon

==Procedure==
#Preheat an [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 200°C.
#[[Cookbook:Creaming|Cream]] together the sugar and butter until they are light and fluffy. The fluffier this mixture, the lighter the finished cake.
#Add both eggs and vanilla, and mix well.
#Add all the flour and baking powder, and mix well.
#Beat with wooden spoon in a circular motion, trying to incorporate as much air as possible.
#Grease 2 round [[Cookbook:Cake Pan|cake tins]] with butter.
#Evenly divide the batter between the 2 pans—make sure the pans are no more than ¾ full.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] the cakes in the preheated oven for about 15 minutes until they are golden. Start checking the cakes after 10 minutes.
#Cool the cakes in the pans, then unmold.
#Spread the frosting and jam over one of the cake layers. Top with the other cake layer. Sprinkle well with the sugar of choice.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==
* A few drops of concentrated [[Cookbook:Food Coloring|food colouring]] or flavoring may be added along with the eggs.
* Unsweetened [[Cookbook:Cocoa Powder|cocoa powder]] may be added to taste. For every 4 g of cocoa you add, remove 3 g of the flour.
* If your eggs don't come out to 200 g, simply adjust the flour, butter, and sugar so that they each weigh the same as the eggs.

steps.text: Preheat an oven to 200°C.
Cream together the sugar and butter until they are light and fluffy. The fluffier this mixture, the lighter the finished cake.
Add both eggs and vanilla, and mix well.
Add all the flour and baking powder, and mix well.
Beat with wooden spoon in a circular motion, trying to incorporate as much air as possible.
Grease 2 round cake tins with butter.
Evenly divide the batter between the 2 pans—make sure the pans are no more than ¾ full.
Bake the cakes in the preheated oven for about 15 minutes until they are golden. Start checking the cakes after 10 minutes.
Cool the cakes in the pans, then unmold.
Spread the frosting and jam over one of the cake layers. Top with the other cake layer. Sprinkle well with the sugar of choice.
